arabicExcerpts.text: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيمٌ
إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ
وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبٖ لِّكُلِّ بَابٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٞ مَّقۡسُومٌ
إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّـٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ
۞نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ٱلۡأَلِيمُ
وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَن ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ
قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ
قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ

mainSubject.label: Iblis refusal rooted in materialist contempt for clay-created humanity; divine respite granted enabling ongoing misguidance mission; satanic strategy of multi-directional ambush producing ingratitude; Adam-Eve garden narrative with prohibition violation and expulsion; earthly enmity established between humanity and Satan with temporal dwelling framework; Abraham's hospitality receiving angelic guests bearing Isaac glad tidings despite old age; despair of divine mercy identified as ultimate misguidance; Lot narrative: hospitality protection versus community transgression; dawn-blast punishment with stone rain as geological sign; destroyed towns remaining as visible highway markers for reflection

subordinateSubjects.label: Iblis alone refused to join the prostrating angels breaking from unanimous obedience
Allah questions Iblis about his absence from the prostrators demanding accountability
Iblis declares refusal based on material superiority rejecting prostration to clay-created being
Divine expulsion pronounced: get out from here for you are now rejected and driven away
Curse placed upon Iblis extending continuously until the Day of Recompense
Iblis requests respite until the Day of Resurrection seeking extended operational timeframe
Allah grants respite confirming Iblis is among those given temporary extension
Respite specified until the Day of the well-known appointed time limiting satanic activity
Iblis vows to beautify disobedience on earth and mislead all humanity in retaliation for divine misguidance
Exception carved out: sincere chosen servants of Allah remain beyond satanic reach
Allah declares a straight path leading back to Him as protected return route
No authority granted to Iblis over divine servants except those who voluntarily follow him in deviation
Hell designated as the promised destination for Iblis and all his followers collectively
Hell has seven gates each assigned a designated portion of the condemned
Righteous promised gardens and springs as reward contrasting with hellfire punishment
Peaceful secure entry into paradise announced to the righteous as welcoming greeting
Resentment removed from hearts of paradise inhabitants making them brothers on facing thrones
No fatigue touches paradise dwellers and they will never be expelled establishing eternal security
Command to inform servants that Allah is the Forgiving and the Merciful balancing hope
Simultaneous warning that divine punishment is the truly painful punishment balancing fear
Narrative introduction directing attention to the guests of Abraham as instructive account
Angelic guests enter Abraham home offering peace but he expresses fear of unknown visitors
Guests reassure Abraham and deliver glad tidings of a knowledgeable son to be born
Abraham questions how glad tidings are possible given his advanced old age expressing astonishment
Guests affirm tidings are given in truth and warn Abraham against despairing of divine power
Abraham rhetorically asks who despairs of Lord mercy except the truly astray affirming hope
Abraham inquires about the broader mission of these dispatched messengers beyond personal tidings
Messengers reveal they are sent to a criminal people indicating impending punitive mission
Lot family explicitly exempted from destruction with promise of complete salvation for all members
Lot wife excluded from salvation decreed to remain among those destroyed as consequence of disbelief

propheticNarratives.label: Iblis refusal to prostrate before Adam based on material superiority claim (fire vs clay) and request for respite to misguide
Adam-Eve garden narrative: dwelling permission with single tree prohibition; Satan's whisper causing fall and expulsion to earthly enmity
Abraham receiving angelic guests bearing Isaac glad tidings; expressing apprehension then accepting divine assurance

Satanic multi-directional ambush strategy: approaching from front behind right left producing ingratitude

relationships.label: Satan-humanity enmity established at creation: Iblis vows to ambush from all directions producing ungratefulness
